user_story: As a parking manager, I want to see current occupancy so that I know whether the lot can accept another vehicle.
description: Expose total, occupied, and available spaces plus an OPEN or FULL lot status through a small API and terminal-friendly view.
acceptance_criteria: Available spaces equal max(capacity minus occupied spaces, zero).
The status is FULL exactly when available spaces are zero.
Successful entry and exit operations update occupancy exactly once.
Availability is never displayed as a negative value.
